scope.method: Static public-source and documentation analysis, per REA routing for complete source repositories.
excluded: Claims of a formal clean-room process
scope.ownership: Implement new Imprint Doc Gen TypeScript code from a written behavior specification and OOXML standards. A fork retains upstream copyright and notices; it is not exclusive ownership of upstream code.

findings.claim: Compilation and rendering are separate stages; per-part XmlTemplater drives XML lexing, delimiter parsing, module parsing, postparse and rendering.
Lexer concatenates text-part content for delimiter detection, then maps delimiter offsets back to original parts. This supports placeholder recognition across XML text runs.
Parser assembles placeholder text across intervening XML tokens, retains tail parts, and selects module matchers before a generic placeholder fallback.
Rendering dispatches parts to modules, retains unhandled content/tag parts, accumulates errors and then collects rendered values.
The public core has an MIT licensing option. A copy or substantial reuse must retain the required copyright and permission notice.
Office packages contain XML parts and relationships; OOXML defines document representation and packaging independently of Docxtemplater.
Image placement uses an image part, a part relationship and drawing markup including image reference and dimensions.

reference_only: Docxtemplater public core for optional development-time behavior comparison

modules.name: package
modules.responsibility: Read bounded ZIP entries, resolve OPC relationships and content types, preserve unrelated entries, reject ambiguous duplicate paths and malformed input.

modules.name: compiler
modules.responsibility: Build namespace-aware source spans and logical text groups; recognize tags split across runs; produce an immutable document plan with source locations. Preserve untouched XML spans instead of serializing entire documents.

modules.name: expressions
modules.responsibility: Interpret data paths, conditions and registered formatters; JSON-only input, own-property access and blocked prototype keys; no arbitrary JavaScript execution.

modules.name: structure
modules.responsibility: Model repeated paragraphs and table rows with explicit boundaries, nesting and section-property rules; reject unsupported overlapping ranges.

modules.name: renderer
modules.responsibility: Create a fresh scope stack and package mutation set per job; escape inserted text and preserve styles outside replacements.

modules.name: assets
modules.responsibility: Resolve attachments through an injected resolver, normalize with sharp, allocate media and relationship IDs, and render image bindings in the current loop scope.

modules.name: docx
modules.responsibility: Implement Word-specific body, header, footer, table, drawing and whitespace behavior.

modules.name: pptx_and_xlsx
modules.responsibility: Later format adapters; do not assume Word repetition semantics apply to slides or spreadsheet formulas.

image_first_contract: Bind an existing placeholder picture to an attachment key using documented alternative text syntax.
Resolve each binding against the current repeated-item scope.
Preserve picture position and apply explicit contain/cover geometry policy.
Allocate relationships in the owning document/header/footer part; avoid changing other pictures that share original media.
Use fresh drawing identifiers as required when repeating structural fragments.
Choose and document missing-image behavior instead of silently producing broken relationships.
api_intent: compile(templateBytes, options) returns an immutable compiled template
render(compiledTemplate, data, attachments) returns document bytes
design.compatibility: Start with a documented Imprint Doc Gen syntax. Carbone syntax and Docxtemplater syntax are separate optional adapters with explicit supported subsets.
design.maintenance_tradeoff: Owning the template engine adds format-correctness and regression maintenance. Existing ZIP, XML, image and PDF components remain dependencies.

fixtures: Placeholder split across styled text runs, including escaped XML characters and Unicode
Scalar replacement preserving surrounding formatting and significant whitespace
Nested table-row loops with correct item and parent scopes
Empty lists and false conditions preserving valid document structure
Two repeated rows with different image attachments
Two pictures sharing original media where only one binding changes
Body, header and footer image relationships
Section breaks, page breaks and merged table cells
Missing data, malformed tags and unsupported structures with source-located errors
Bounded ZIP expansion, deeply nested expressions and render cancellation
Parallel rendering from the same immutable compiled template without shared state
Word/LibreOffice opening plus PDF visual regression of our own fixtures
validation.comparison: Compare documented text/loop behavior against the public core where semantics match; compare images against our expected fixtures and OOXML requirements, not uninspected paid modules.

loop_and_scope_findings.claim: Loop delimiter pairs are validated, expanded to structural boundaries and recursively compiled. Rendering has specific handling for Word section properties, header/footer references and page breaks, plus PowerPoint table row identifiers and shape height.

Scope frames track nested iteration identity. Null/undefined lookup results fall back to parent scopes; false, zero and empty strings remain resolved values. Async resolution retains nested iteration identity. Imprint Doc Gen must explicitly define these semantics, including whether explicit null should fall back.
